mapper.select: SELECT i.product_id::text AS product_id, i.product_name AS product_name, MAX(i.spec) AS spec, COALESCE(SUM(i.qty), 0) AS qty, COALESCE(SUM(i.net_amount), 0) AS amount, COALESCE(SUM(i.profit), 0) AS profit, CASE WHEN COALESCE(SUM(i.net_amount), 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(SUM(i.profit), 0) / SUM(i.net_amount) END AS profit_rate FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id = i.order_id WHERE o.deleted_at IS NULL AND o.status IN ('approved', 'shipped', 'partial', 'closed') AND o.order_date >= #{from} AND o.order_date <= #{to} GROUP BY i.product_id, i.product_name ORDER BY amount DESC LIMIT #{limit}
